verdict.rationale: GitLab documents a public API for programmatic interaction (gitlab-docs-10), supports authentication via PATs and SSH keys for API access (gitlab-docs-5, gitlab-docs-6), and additionally exposes an official CLI (gitlab-probe-3) and MCP server (gitlab-probe-2) enabling AI-native/agentic access. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration of API usage/reliability and more detail on API completeness/rate limits.
